snippet.title: A Home Below - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3470880/A_Home_Below/

A Home Below is a 3D underwater story-driven game where you play as a hermit crab exploring the ruins of a house that’s been lost to the sea. 

Set in near-future North Wales and inspired by real climate stories of flooding and sea-level rise threatening to submerge coastal towns, discover the remnants of the Salt family's once-loved home, piecing together what happened to them by inspecting the household objects and memories they have left behind. 

Interact with a house full of creatures, from skittish sea urchins and helpful anemones to scary wrasse and a curious Octopus. Make friends, evade predators, find food to grow, and seek shells, getting swept up in an adventure that will take you from room to room of this vast underwater house.
